::: {#rem-arithmetic-code-source}
#### Where arithmetic codes come from

@cover2006elements [section 5.9] gives Shannon--Fano--Elias coding,
which assigns each value a codeword from the midpoint of its slice of $[0, 1)$ in the way that @def-arithmetic-code does for a whole message.
They describe arithmetic coding,
which finds the slice of a long message one value at a time,
in section 13.3.

:::
